Q00234_FatesWhisper/30847-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Why are you still here? You must hurry and take the Hammer of Maestro Reorin back to its original owner! There is no time to lose!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30847-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Do you know Reorin? Then I suppose you've heard the news of his pardon! He's been reinstated as a regular guildsman! In the nick of time if you ask me. The guild could not afford to lose a maestro such as him. What's that? You are here for the Hammer of Maestro Reorin ? Yes!…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30847-03.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Are you by any chance on your way to meet Maestro Reorin? Please relay my congratulations to him and tell him that I eagerly await his new work!

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30078-01.html.text: Grocer Pano: I operate this grocery store for a living, but my passion is collecting coins! Wait, I want to show you my collection... Ah, right. Here it is. ook at my coins...! I collect medium grade coins . Do you see anything you like?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30092-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Collob: Now let me think... Where did I put it? Ah, yes. Here it is. These are the coins that I have... I ?need a medium grade coin . See anything you like?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30847-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: I have only recently become a level 1 member so please bear with me. What do you wish to exchange? These are the only coins I have... To trade with me, you must have a medium grade coin . Would you like one of my coins?

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30078-54.html.text: Grocer Pano: You must find a level 2 or level 3 member. I am a level 1 member and thus can only deal with other level 1 members. If I violate this rule I could get kicked out of the guild...

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30092-54.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Collob: I beg your pardon, I am only a level 1 member... I cannot trade with higher-level members. It means nothing that you are a regular customer here... I apologize.

Q00336_CoinsOfMagic/30847-54.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Being a level 1 member I can only trade with other level 1 members... Don't be discouraged. You need only find a member of your own level to trade with.

Q00036_MakeASewingKit/30847-03.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: I need some enchanted iron . It's made by applying magic to Iron Ore. There aren't any Mystics around, so we'll have to improvise... A creature known as the enchanted iron golem can be found in the vicinity of the Ivory Tower. Peel off some of its scrap and bring it to me! I…

Q00036_MakeASewingKit/30847-06.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: I need 10 Artisan's Frames and 10 Oriharukons. Most any Warsmith should be able to make an Artisan's Frame. Finding Oriharukon will be more challenging. Occasionally you can find someone selling it in the village.

Q00036_MakeASewingKit/30847-09.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Oh, thank you! You don't mind waiting a moment, do you? It shouldn't take too long... Here's the Sewing kit Leikar requested. It's sturdy, and she can make anything she wants with it! Give Leikar my regards!

Q00036_MakeASewingKit/30847-10.html.text: Head Blacksmith Ferris: Where are the ingredients? I can't make the item without them.
